_comment: sim-preplace-level-gate-v1: GATE the carried pre-place APPROACH to the high from-above collect standoff on the predicted EXECUTED (droop) carton tilt, and CAP the carried-carton dynamics, so the welded carton stays parallel to the ground (2.0 deg bound, 0.15 s grace, NEVER loosened) through the preplace. ROOT CAUSE (coldwin50, CARTON_TILT roll +1.98 pitch +7.64 deg at preplace, base rock-steady, PR 339 full D6 lock never reached): the integration-worker forensics (coldwin50-preplace.txt) proved cw49 and cw50 commanded the SAME standoff IK branch (every joint within 0.003 rad) whose STATIC droop-executed tilt is only ~1.6 deg -- the 7.64 is run-to-run DYNAMIC deflection during a COARSE, FAST preplace sweep (a 9-point cuMotion move_group plan: pan -1.35 rad, wrist_2 +1.64 rad). Two static gaps enabled it: (1) the carried APPROACH to the standoff levelled only the GEOMETRIC interior wrists, so the EXECUTED (drooped) interior still pitched ~1.7 deg (CPU-confirmed 1.689), and the approach plan gate replayed the GEOMETRIC path (predict_path_tilt, droop-blind) so it never saw it; (2) the coarse fast sweep deflected dynamically. The fix closes BOTH and is default-OFF (byte-identical).

_mechanism.1_level_standoff_solve: carton_level.solve_level_standoff: the standoff IK is solved on the branch with the SMALLEST predicted EXECUTED (droop) tilt + the most clearance (level_place_ik(gravity_comp) already returns an executed-level standoff -- CPU 0.038 deg -- but ranks by nearest-seed, not executed tilt). Fast path: the nominal reach-validated branch is tried first and returned when already executed-level on a clear branch.
_mechanism.2_droop_compensated_densified_approach: carton_level.plan_compensated_approach: the carry/tuck -> standoff approach is a leveled waypoint path whose EVERY interior waypoint is geometrically levelled THEN wrist-droop-cancelled against its OWN loaded droop (gc.wrist_feedforward), so the EXECUTED carton stays level THROUGHOUT (CPU: the geometric-interior approach executed 1.689 -> the compensated approach 0.043), and the path is DENSIFIED to densify_count(start, goal, preplace_max_segment_rad) segments (the 132-point lesson: no coarse 9-pt sweeps).
_mechanism.3_droop_aware_gate: the move is gated on the predicted EXECUTED (droop-aware) tilt: a residual over preplace_gate_bound_deg (the bound minus a margin, 1.0 deg) is logged (the dynamics cap + closed loop own it), and a predicted executed over the TRUE bound_deg (2.0) is CARTON_LEVEL_PLAN_REJECTED before ANY motion (never a visibly-tilted carry).
_mechanism.4_dynamics_cap: the carried approach is dispatched as begin_joint_path at preplace_approach_speed / preplace_approach_accel (lower peak joint velocity => less dynamic deflection). CPU velocity replay: a coarse 9-pt cuMotion-style sweep (arm_max_speed 0.3) peaks 0.45 rad/s / 4.9 rad/s^2; the densified capped approach peaks 0.05 rad/s / 0.035 rad/s^2. The gate line logs peak_joint_speed + peak_accel.
_mechanism.5_closed_loop_backstop: when closed_loop_level is also on, the bounded MODEL closed-loop servo (CartonLevelServo.correct_path, NOT the sensor-anchored variant -- which would double-count the droop a pre-compensated path already cancelled) is extended to the approach interior as a residual backstop (authority closed_loop_authority_deg).

env._note: UNCHANGED from coldwin49/coldwin50. The gate is scoped to the collect preplace approach; no new env switch.

host_config._file: scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json (resolved by ros_host.py -> carton_level.resolve_level_config -> TransferController). The ONLY new keys this lane adds are the five preplace_* keys under carton_level below; everything else is the coldwin50 block (PR 338 preplace_above_support + PR 339 station full brake), UNCHANGED.

carton_level._preplace_level_gate_note: NEW. ON => the collect preplace approach is the droop-compensated, densified, speed/accel-capped, gated path above. It ENGAGES only when the standoff is re-targeted above the support (preplace_above_support / preplace_above_place), so config_preflight.check_carton_level REFUSES preplace_level_gate ON with neither above-flag (silently-inert guard). OFF (default) => the single leveled-endpoint approach (sim-carton-level-preplace-v1), byte-identical.
carton_level._preplace_gate_bound_deg_note: NEW, OPTIONAL (default 1.0 = bound 2.0 minus a 1.0 deg margin). The predicted-EXECUTED-tilt TARGET the compensated approach aims for; a sub-bound residual over it is logged (dynamics cap + closed loop own it), a predicted executed over the TRUE bound_deg (2.0) is refused before motion. Must be in (0, bound_deg].
carton_level._preplace_max_segment_rad_note: NEW, OPTIONAL (default 0.25). The max per-joint step per densified approach segment -- splits the fast pan/wrist sweep into short level segments. A tighter value => more waypoints => lower per-segment peak joint velocity.
carton_level._preplace_approach_speed_accel_note: NEW, OPTIONAL (default 0.05 rad/s, 0.1 rad/s^2; clamped to the host ceilings 0.08 / 0.15). The carried approach joint speed/accel caps passed to begin_joint_path -- the dynamics lever against the welded carton's run-to-run deflection.
carton_level._kept_note: ALL the coldwin49/coldwin50 carton_level keys are KEPT verbatim (preplace_above_support derives the standoff above the shelf; contact release + gap; droop K=2850; droop-aware clearance; from-above). This lane only adds the five preplace_* gate/dynamics keys. closed_loop_sensor stays for the PLACE descent; the preplace approach uses the MODEL closed loop (not the sensor anchor), decided internally.

host_config._other_host_keys_unchanged: collect_place_preplace_shape (the IK seed + the no-support fallback), collect_place_straight_line, collect_place_wrist_guard, carry_wrist1_cap / carry_wrist2_min, release_detach_timeout_s -- all UNCHANGED from coldwin50. PR 339 RUNTIME keys (station_place_full_brake etc.) UNCHANGED.

runtime_config._file: mission-runtime-*.json (EXTERNAL to the repo; the integration lane owns it). UNCHANGED from coldwin50 -- incl. the PR 339 RUNTIME full-brake keys (station_place_full_brake, chassis_station_pitch_hold_*) that this lane does NOT touch.

cart_placement._note: UNCHANGED from coldwin49/50: the UPPER shelf (resolved top ~0.9707 world).

config_preflight._check_carton_level: resolve_level_config validates the five new keys (preplace_gate_bound_deg in (0, bound_deg]; the rest finite positive). NEW coherence refusal: preplace_level_gate ON with neither preplace_above_support nor preplace_above_place -> 'the gate engages only on the re-targeted above-support preplace standoff, so with neither it is silently inert'. Deck / no support_prim / gate OFF => no new refusal (byte-identical).

_acceptance_coldwin51: CARTON_SEGMENT_TILT phase=preplace executed <= 1.5 deg (the preplace sweep no longer reaches the 2.0 bound), with the peak joint velocity logged on the CARTON_LEVEL_PREPLACE_GATE line; NO CARTON_TILT trip at preplace; the run REACHES place, where the PR 339 full D6 lock engages at place start (STATION_FULL_BRAKE / base drift <= 0.02 m -- validated for the first time, the coldwin50 premise that it was never exercised); PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE fires at TRUE shelf contact (carton bottom within place_contact_gap_m of the measured ~0.9707 world shelf top, descent_drop ~0.08 not 0.0); verify_place PASSES (carton resting, xy in tol, bottom_gap ~0); and the run ADVANCES PAST COLLECT. The 2.0 deg bound, 0.15 s grace, carton dims, droop stiffness, tow lanes and the brake are UNCHANGED.
_cpu_proof: PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m pytest scripts/twin/tests/test_preplace_level_gate_v1.py -- config resolve/validate (the five keys, defaults, off byte-identical, the gate-bound<=bound rule); densify_count scaling; solve_level_standoff (executed-level + reach + clear branch); the cw50 gap reproduction (geometric-interior approach executed 1.689 > the 1.0 gate target; the droop-compensated densified approach 0.043 <= 1.0) and the dynamics velocity replay (coarse 9-pt cuMotion sweep peak 0.45/4.9 vs the capped densified 0.05/0.035); the CARTON_LEVEL_PLAN_REJECTED refusal path; config_preflight (gate-without-above refused, gate-with-above-support clean, off byte-identical, malformed refused); and the controller gated dispatch (one densified capped begin_joint_path, the planned preplace tilt stashed for CARTON_SEGMENT_TILT). Default-off => byte-identical (the full carton_level suite stays green except the one documented pre-existing preplace fixture-URDF inversion failure).
